item.title: Fuzzing Commands - OSCP|CTF
item.description: Most useful fuzzing commands!!! WFUZZ XSS: wfuzz -c -z file,/usr/share/wfuzz/wordlist/Injections/XSS.txt -d "doi=FUZZ" "$URL" PARAMETERS: wfuzz -c -z file,/usr/share/seclists/Discovery/Web-Content/raft-large-directories.txt --hc 404 "$URL" DIRECTORIES: normal wfuzz -c -z file,/usr/share/seclists/Discovery/Web-Content/raft-large-directories.txt --hc 404 "$URL" lowercase wfuzz -c -z /usr/share/seclists/Discovery/Web-Content/raft-large-directories-lowercase.txt --hc 404 "$URL" FILES: check files: wfuzz -c -z file,/usr/share/seclists/Discovery/Web-Content/raft-large-files.txt --hc 404 "$URL" large words: wfuzz -c -z file,/usr/share/seclists/Discovery/Web-Content/raft-large-words.txt --hc 404 "$URL" users: wfuzz -c -z file,/usr/share/seclists/Usernames/top-usernames-shortlist.txt --hc 404,403 "$URL" SMTP USER ENUM VRFY smtp-user-enum -M VRFY -U /usr/share/seclists/Usernames/xato-net-10-million-usernames.

item.title: Try This - OSCP|CTF
item.description: Did you get stuck during a CTF? Don’t Worry 😌, I must have missed something. Try this!!! No vulnerabilities found? General: Do a full nmap. Make sure to check known vulnerabilities with all services. Examples :- smb nmap --script smb-vuln* -Pn -p 139,445 {IP} Try common passwords with servers. Examples:- admin:admin, admin:password With weblogins,FTP, anything Check similar type HTB boxes. Google ipsecc. Having troubles with nmap Use -Pn Try again filtered ports Nothing in HTTP/S Check robots.
